overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Data Enhanced Emerging Markets Equity ETF (GEMQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The Goldman Sachs Data Enhanced Emerging Markets Equity ETF (the Fund) seeks long-term growth of capital. GEMQ was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.
